{{Current events header|2016|05|26}}

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Iraqi civil war (2014–present)|Iraqi civil war]]
**[[Operation Breaking Terrorism]]
***[[Iraqi Armed Forces|Iraqi security forces]] and [[Shia Islam|Shiite]] [[Popular Mobilization Forces (Iraq)|Popular Mobilization Forces]] recapture [[Al-Karmah]], about 16 kilometers (10 miles) northeast of [[Fallujah]]. [http://www.cnn.com/2016/05/26/middleeast/iraq-karma-falluja/ (CNN)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Two [[United States Navy]] [[FA-18]]'s crash in the [[Atlantic Ocean]] near the [[Outer Banks]] off the coast of the US state of [[North Carolina]].  The four pilots safely [[Ejection seat|ejected]] from the planes and   are being examined in [[Sentara Norfolk General Hospital]] in [[Virginia]]. [http://pilotonline.com/news/military/local/navy-two-f-a--s-crash-in-atlantic-ocean/article_bbffcdd9-0820-5603-aa9f-2e2120dbfd6a.html (Virginian Pilot)] [http://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2016/05/26/US-fighter-jets-crash-off-North-Carolina-coast-4-on-board-rescued/3471464279219/?spt=hs&or=tn_us (UPI)]
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**At least 20 people drown  in the southern [[Mediterranean Sea]] when a [[Repurposing|repurposed]] [[Fishing vessel|fishing boat]] sinks 35 nautical miles north of  [[Zuwarah|Zuwara]], [[Libya]]. [http://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/may/26/migrant-boat-capsizes-in-mediterranean-italian-coastguard (''The Guardian'')]

;Health and medicine
*Researchers at the [[United States Department of Defense]] report, in  the ''[[Antimicrobial Agents and Chemotherapy]]'' journal, the discovery for the first time in the United States  of a strain of [[E. coli]] that includes the new, dreaded gene [[MCR-1]], that is resistant to  [[colistin]], a  [[Drug of last resort|last-resort]] [[Antibiotics|antibiotic]]. [http://phenomena.nationalgeographic.com/2016/05/26/colistin-r-9/ (National Geographic)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/to-your-health/wp/2016/05/26/the-superbug-that-doctors-have-been-dreading-just-reached-the-u-s/?hpid=hp_rhp-top-table-main_tyh-superbug-255pm%3Ahomepage%2Fstory (''The Washington Post'')]  [http://aac.asm.org/content/early/2016/05/25/AAC.01103-16.full.pdf+html {''Antimicrobial Agents and Chemotherapy'')]

;International relations
*Chinese state media [[Xinhua News Agency]] criticizes [[Taiwan]] [[President of the Republic of China|President]] [[Tsai Ing-wen]] as "extreme" politically and lacking emotional balance. [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-36375963 (BBC)] [http://www.nytimes.com/2016/05/26/world/asia/china-taiwan-tsai-unmarried-single.html?_r=0 (''The New York Times'')]
* [[South Korea]] plans to import arms worth about 3.5 trillion [[South Korean won|won]] (US$3 billion) this year  to enhance its defense capabilities. [http://www.upi.com/Business_News/Security-Industry/2016/05/26/South-Korea-to-import-3-billion-worth-of-arms/8361464272886/?spt=hs&or=si (UPI)] [http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/national/2016/05/25/0301000000AEN20160525005500315.html (Yonhap)]

;Law and crime
*[[President of Indonesia|Indonesian President]] [[Joko Widodo]] issues an executive order (Perppu) making [[child sexual abuse]] punishable by [[chemical castration]] and extends the maximum penalty to death. The move comes after a teenage girl was [[gang rape]]d and murdered by a group of 14 men and boys while walking home from school in [[Sumatra]] last month. [http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2016/05/26/Indonesia-to-punish-child-sex-abuse-offenders-with-chemical-castration/3971464259113/ (UPI)] [http://time.com/4348788/indonesia-chemical-castration-sex-offenses/ (''Time'')]

;Politics and elections
*French labor unions implement a strike in protest of proposed reforms to labor laws. [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-36385778 (BBC)]
*[[United States presidential election, 2016]]
**The [[Associated Press]] reports that [[Donald Trump]] has secured enough delegates to secure the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican Party]] nomination for President. [http://bigstory.ap.org/article/6fb6b090e8734d8593c0dc65658a4afa/trump-reaches-magic-number-delegates-clinch-nomination (AP)]
